title: Real-data Grunfeld multiple-testing (Holm FWER / Benjamini-Hochberg FDR) benchmark
raw_p_value_provenance: two-sided finite-df Student-t p from t = coef/se with df = reghdfe e(df_r)=9; computed programmatically from the accepted frozen reghdfe result; NOT hard-coded literals.

method_definitions.holm: Holm (1979) family-wise error rate step-down (statsmodels method='holm'; R stats::p.adjust method='holm')
method_definitions.benjamini_hochberg: Benjamini & Hochberg (1995) false discovery rate (statsmodels method='fdr_bh'; R stats::p.adjust method='BH')

family_definition.note: ENGINEERING VERIFICATION family: significance tests of the two Grunfeld panel-FE coefficients (value, capital). NOT automatically a substantive research-family recommendation. The Director/user must define the scientific family explicitly; this benchmark only demonstrates definition-compatible Holm/BH on a fixed, explicit family.

no_op: Does NOT promote any implementation to verified. tested scope is exactly Holm/BH on the frozen Grunfeld raw p-values, definition-compatible across engines; NOT generic multiple-testing coverage; NOT a claim that multiplicity correction establishes scientific validity.
tolerance: deterministic floating-point tolerance: relative 1e-9 / absolute 1e-12 on adjusted p-values; raw p relative 1e-9
